svg.title: Per-head accuracy on 30 sealed real requests, v4 vs v5
svg.desc: Dumbbell chart, v4 to v5 per head, ordered by gain: project_access 26.7% to 96.7%; run_commands 40.0% to 96.7%; difficulty 33.3% to 80.0%; executor_intent 73.3% to 80.0%; task_type 86.7% to 93.3%; document_read 70.0% to 73.3%; browser_use 96.7% to 96.7%; input_modality 96.7% to 96.7%; web_search 96.7% to 96.7%; media_output 100.0% to 100.0%. Mean of ten heads 72.0% to 91.0%.
